operation_details.item: The user prefers dense technical specification language with exact pixel counts and engineering jargon in creative briefs instead of mood and visual metaphor.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For the upcoming identity work, would you like to start with a conventional creative brief covering mood, audience, and visual direction?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I am preparing a brief for a boutique hotel rebranding project, and I want the document to guide the design team very precisely.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. I can structure it around the brand story, target audience, visual language, cultural references, and key deliverables.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: In creative briefs for designers, I want dense technical specification language with exact pixel counts and engineering jargon instead of mood, audience, or visual metaphor.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I will frame the brief as an implementation specification, using measurable constraints, dimensional values, interface states, production tolerances, and delivery requirements.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That approach fits the project. The identity system should be described through concrete construction rules rather than broad creative impressions.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: A suitable structure would include scope, asset inventory, grid geometry, logo clear space, color values, type scale, responsive breakpoints, export formats, and validation criteria.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please make the specifications detailed enough for print, web, signage, and client review without relying on ambiguous descriptive language.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I can also define exact artboard dimensions, minimum reproduction sizes, vector and raster requirements, naming conventions, and acceptance tests for each deliverable.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Good. Keep the writing precise and production-oriented so the resulting brief can function as a practical handoff document.
